title: On the Existence of an Extremal Function for the Delsarte Extremal Problem

predicted_errors.supporting_evidence: The paper defines supp f := {g in G : f(g) != 0}. This is not the standard definition; the support of a function is the closure of that set. The misdefinition affects the meaning of conditions such as supp f_+ subset Ω, since the set {f>0} is not closed in general.
